up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1212812'. For each such compound, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its max phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). List the results in ascending order of the compound's ChEMBL ID. Ensure that each compound appears only once (i.e., deduplicate if multiple compound records reference the same molecule).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.molecule_type,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1212812'
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
